7522.title: Pi system boundaries retain duplicate snapshots
7522.rootCauseOneLine: System-role message boundaries are classified as unknown, so both retain full raw envelopes as diagnostic events.
7522.proposedFix: Recognize system boundaries under the existing noise policy while preserving unknown-role diagnostics.
7522.caveats: Synthetic translation/assembly reproduction repeated in two clean trusted checkouts; no live Pi session or reporter database was inspected. Full regression patch is inline.
